author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: বাক্যটিকে Indirect Speech-এ রূপান্তর করো (Board: narrative style, 7 marks)।

items.original: He said to me, "I know you."
a: He told me that he knew me.
She said that she was reading then.

items.original: Father said to me, "May you shine in life!"
a: Father prayed that I might shine in life.
Father wished that I might shine in life.
He exclaimed with sorrow that he was undone.

items.original: The teacher said to the boys, "Do the work."
a: The teacher ordered the boys to do the work.
items.rule_bn: আদেশে: ordered + object + to + base verb।

items.original: He said to her, "Will you help me?"
a: He asked her if she would help him.
He asked her whether she would help him.
Mother proposed that we should go home.
Mother suggested that we should go home.
He said that man is mortal.
items.rule_bn: চিরন্তন সত্য হলে tense অপরিবর্তিত: is।
